title: Lease presence core
description: Objective: implement fenced assignment, workspace, resource, and provider-slot lease state plus separate non-authoritative presence. Deliverable: scheduler authority modules with epoch, renew, suspect, drain, revoke, and race property tests. NOT in scope: provider launch, OS locks, policy decisions, or graph fan-out. Hard dependencies: Runtime contract registry and Identity session core. Owned paths: packages/scheduler/src/authority/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test.
definitionOfDone: Every authority mutation requires the current token and epoch; stale renew/release/complete has zero business effect.
Presence cannot create, renew, steal, or release a lease.
Suspect, drain, revoke, handoff, and restart races end in one legal deterministic state.
The focused scheduler typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Follow the pinned design; this task cannot create authority beyond its named contract.
Fail closed with stable codes and immutable deterministic outputs.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400.
Use TDD and stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, or merge.
